briefdescription.para: Append-only, rotating audit trail for storage-layer events.

detaileddescription.para: StorageAuditLogger records every significant storage mutation (PUT, DEL, CHECKPOINT, RECOVERY, COMPACTION, SNAPSHOT) to a text log file so that compliance tools and post-mortem forensics can reconstruct the history of the database.

sect2.title: Log entry format (one line per event)
Log rotation
sect2.para: When the active log file exceeds Config::max_file_bytes, it is closed and a new segment is opened (audit_000001.log, audit_000002.log, …).
